issues: Whether an arbitrator's interpretation of a contract clause constitutes a question of law, question of fact, or question of mixed fact and law for purposes of appeal
What standard of review applies to an appeal of an arbitral award on contract interpretation
Whether the parties' arbitration agreement permits appeals on questions of law, and if so what leave requirements or limitations apply
Whether the arbitration is governed by domestic or international commercial arbitration legislation, which affects appealability
key_facts: The parties are in a commercial agreement containing an arbitration clause
A dispute arose over the interpretation of a clause in the agreement
An arbitrator has issued an interpretation of the disputed clause
One party now wishes to appeal that interpretation
causes_of_action: Application to set aside or seek leave to appeal an arbitration award
